title: HSK 2.7 · 交通, 打算, 颜色, 舒服, 留下
focus: 懂 · 卡 · 算 · 辆 · 药 · 留 · 交 · 套 · 黑 · 店 · 服务 · 挺 · 克 · 装 · 座 · 往 · 眼 · 清楚 · 停 · 酒 · 红 · 眼睛 · 通 · 留下 · 通知 · 普通 · 打算 · 交给 · 酒店 · 交通 · 颜色 · 以下 · 以上 · 红色 · 放下 · 舒服 · 上周 · 黑色 · 绿色
body:
Colors (色 with 红, 黑, 绿), getting around (交通, 通知, 辆) and lots of single-character verbs and measure words. 交 hand over and 通 go through combine into 交通 traffic.

## Characters that repeat

| Character | Pinyin | Meaning | In this lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| 色 | sè | color | 颜色, 红色, 黑色, 绿色 |
| 通 | tōng | go through, connect (辶 + 甬 sound) | 通, 通知, 普通, 交通 |
| 交 | jiāo | to hand over; to make (friends) | 交, 交给, 交通 |
| 下 | xià | down, below | 留下, 以下, 放下 |
| 红 | hóng | red (纟 + 工 gōng sound) | 红, 红色 |
| 黑 | hēi | black | 黑, 黑色 |
| 店 | diàn | shop (广 building + 占 sound) | 店, 酒店 |
| 眼 | yǎn | eye (目 + 艮) | 眼, 眼睛 |

## Watch out

- 往 wǎng (toward) has 彳 'step'; 住 zhù (live) has 亻 person.
- 卡 is kǎ for card (银行卡), qiǎ for stuck.
- 酒店 is usually a hotel, not a liquor store.

cards.Example: 你懂我的意思吗？ nǐ dǒng wǒ de yìsi ma: Do you get what I mean?
cards.Notes: 忄 heart + 董 dǒng (sound) = understanding in the heart. 听懂 understand by listening

cards.Example: 我的银行卡呢？ wǒ de yínháng kǎ ne: Where's my bank card?
cards.Notes: 上 up + 下 down: stuck in between (read qiǎ, 卡住). Used for the sound of English 'card' (kǎ)

cards.Example: 你算一下多少钱。 nǐ suàn yíxià duōshao qián: Work out how much it is
cards.Notes: ⺮ bamboo + 目 + 廾 two hands: counting with bamboo rods. 算了 = forget it

cards.Example: 门口有一辆车。 ménkǒu yǒu yí liàng chē: There's a car at the door
cards.Notes: 车 vehicle + 两 liǎng (sound) = measure word for cars, bikes

cards.Example: 你吃药了吗？ nǐ chī yào le ma: Have you taken your medicine?
cards.Notes: 艹 grass, herbs + 约 yuē (sound): herbal medicine. 吃药 = take medicine

cards.Meaning: to stay; to keep; to leave (behind)
cards.Example: 给我留一点。 gěi wǒ liú yìdiǎn: Save a bit for me
cards.Notes: 田 field at the bottom + top part (sound). 留学 study abroad, 留言 leave a message

cards.Example: 明天交作业。 míngtiān jiāo zuòyè: Homework is due tomorrow
cards.Notes: Picture of a person with crossed legs: crossing, exchange. 交朋友 make friends

cards.Meaning: set; (measure word for sets, apartments); cover
cards.Example: 我买了一套房子。 wǒ mǎi le yí tào fángzi: I bought an apartment
cards.Notes: 大 big on top of 長 long (shortened): a cover over something. 一套 = a set

cards.Example: 外面天黑了。 wàimiàn tiān hēi le: It's dark outside
cards.Notes: Bottom four dots look like 灬 fire; think of soot from a fire: black, dark

cards.Example: 这家店很有名。 zhè jiā diàn hěn yǒumíng: This shop is famous
cards.Notes: 广 building + 占 zhàn (sound) = shop. 商店, 书店, 饭店

cards.Example: 这里的服务很好。 zhèlǐ de fúwù hěn hǎo: The service here is great
cards.Notes: 服 serve + 务 affairs, work = service. 服务员 waiter

cards.Example: 这个挺好的。 zhège tǐng hǎo de: This is pretty good
cards.Notes: 扌 hand + 廷 tíng (sound). Spoken 'quite': 挺…的

cards.Example: 我要五百克。 wǒ yào wǔbǎi kè: I'd like 500 grams
cards.Notes: Also 'to overcome' (克服). Used to write 'gram' and many foreign names (克林顿 Clinton)

cards.Meaning: to pack, load; to install; to pretend
cards.Example: 他在装睡。 tā zài zhuāng shuì: He's pretending to sleep
cards.Notes: 衣 clothing (bottom) + 壮 zhuàng (sound): dress up, so pack, install, pretend

cards.Example: 那座山很高。 nà zuò shān hěn gāo: That mountain is tall
cards.Notes: 广 building + 坐 zuò sit (also sound) = a seat. 座位 seat

cards.Example: 一直往前走。 yìzhí wǎng qián zǒu: Go straight ahead
cards.Notes: 彳 step + right part (originally a sound part) = go toward. Lookalike: 住 zhù live (亻 not 彳)

cards.Example: 我眼有点疼。 wǒ yǎn yǒudiǎn téng: My eyes hurt a bit
cards.Notes: 目 eye + 艮 (sound) = eye. Mostly in words: 眼睛, 眼镜 glasses

cards.Example: 我听不清楚。 wǒ tīng bu qīngchu: I can't hear clearly.
cards.Notes: 清 = 氵 water + 青 qīng: clear like water

cards.Example: 车停在哪儿？ chē tíng zài nǎr: Where's the car parked?
cards.Notes: 亻 person + 亭 tíng pavilion (also sound): a person stopping at a rest pavilion

cards.Example: 他不喝酒。 tā bù hē jiǔ: He doesn't drink
cards.Notes: 氵 liquid + 酉 wine jar = alcohol. 啤酒 beer

cards.Example: 她的脸红了。 tā de liǎn hóng le: She blushed
cards.Notes: 纟 silk + 工 gōng (sound): dyed red silk. 红 can also mean popular: 很红

cards.Example: 她的眼睛大大的。 tā de yǎnjing dàdà de: She has big eyes.
cards.Notes: Both have 目 eye: 眼 = 目 + 艮, 睛 = 目 + 青

cards.Example: 电话打不通。 diànhuà dǎ bu tōng: The call won't go through
cards.Notes: 辶 movement + 甬 yǒng (sound) = to go through. 一通电话 is tòng

cards.Example: 请留下你的名字。 qǐng liúxià nǐ de míngzi: Please leave your name
cards.Notes: 留 stay, keep + 下 down = leave behind, stay on

cards.Example: 我会通知你。 wǒ huì tōngzhī nǐ: I'll let you know
cards.Notes: 通 pass through + 知 know = pass the word on, notify

cards.Example: 我是一个普通人。 wǒ shì yí ge pǔtōng rén: I'm an ordinary person
cards.Notes: 普 general, universal + 通 common = ordinary. 普通话 Mandarin

cards.Example: 你打算去哪儿？ nǐ dǎsuàn qù nǎr: Where are you planning to go?
cards.Notes: 打 (do) + 算 calculate = to reckon ahead, plan

cards.Example: 把这个交给老师。 bǎ zhège jiāogěi lǎoshī: Give this to the teacher
cards.Notes: 交 hand over + 给 to = hand over to someone

cards.Example: 我们住在酒店。 wǒmen zhù zài jiǔdiàn: We're staying at a hotel
cards.Notes: 酒 wine + 店 shop = originally a tavern; today mostly 'hotel'

cards.Example: 这里交通很方便。 zhèlǐ jiāotōng hěn fāngbiàn: Getting around here is easy
cards.Notes: 交 cross + 通 go through = routes that cross and connect: traffic

cards.Example: 你喜欢什么颜色？ nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè: What color do you like?
cards.Notes: 颜 face, complexion (页 head) + 色 color = color

cards.Example: 十岁以下的孩子。 shí suì yǐxià de háizi: Children under ten
cards.Notes: 以 (from) + 下 below = from here down

cards.Example: 十八岁以上可以进。 shíbā suì yǐshàng kěyǐ jìn: 18 and over can enter
cards.Notes: 以 (from) + 上 above = from here up

cards.Example: 我喜欢红色。 wǒ xǐhuan hóngsè: I like red
cards.Notes: 红 red + 色 color = the color red

cards.Meaning: to put down; to let go
cards.Example: 把书放下吧。 bǎ shū fàngxià ba: Put the book down
cards.Notes: 放 put + 下 down = put down

cards.Example: 我有点不舒服。 wǒ yǒudiǎn bù shūfu: I'm not feeling well
cards.Notes: 舒 relaxed, stretch out + 服 (here: suit, agree with) = comfortable

cards.Example: 上周我去了上海。 shàngzhōu wǒ qù le Shànghǎi: Last week I went to Shanghai
cards.Notes: 上 previous + 周 week = last week. 下周 = next week

cards.Example: 他穿黑色的衣服。 tā chuān hēisè de yīfu: He wears black
cards.Notes: 黑 black + 色 color = black

cards.Example: 树叶是绿色的。 shùyè shì lǜsè de: Leaves are green
cards.Notes: 绿 green (纟 silk + 录 lù, sound) + 色 color = green
